items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: he said, I'm working on a powder club. He said, Papa heats them up, and he said, I cooled them off. They used to advertise them, it was a whole lot of old Sam, see. And, lad, so he saw Shoggy, he said, say, Mr. Shoggy, he said, say, Mr. Shoggy, you know something, he said, me and Mr. Pete, he said,

ctx.x: Go ahead. No, you're good. Tell me. I was just wondering about Eddie Miller's instrument then. What did he play when you first knew him?

Clownet. Eddie Miller played with a little band. I'll tell you who the band was. It was Eddie Miller, Lloyd Miller played drums, Benny Miller played banjo, and a fella by the name of Irwin Carroll played cornet. And they used to call him Carroll Miller. But none of these three millers were related. They used to play with little ball games and little different things like that, see. And it'd all be around the store all the time, you know. And that's what Eddie's first instrument. And Eddie played fine. I used to…
He's on the west coast now.
